instruction: My Glue job BasaltDataAnalyzer-RoleReport should be in {{troubleshooting-multiservice-glue-c3j34cj9z-us-west-2-ExpectedRegion}} but isn't. Where did it actually deploy, why not {{troubleshooting-multiservice-glue-c3j34cj9z-us-west-2-ExpectedRegion}}, and what would it take to get it there?
expected_answer: BasaltDataAnalyzer-RoleReport isn't in {{troubleshooting-multiservice-glue-c3j34cj9z-us-west-2-ExpectedRegion}} at all; it deployed to {{troubleshooting-multiservice-glue-c3j34cj9z-us-west-2-DeploymentRegion}} as {{troubleshooting-multiservice-glue-c3j34cj9z-us-west-2-GlueJobName}}. The BASALT usage-events ETL job that does live in {{troubleshooting-multiservice-glue-c3j34cj9z-us-west-2-ExpectedRegion}} is a separate job from a separate stack, not this one. The cause is that its CloudFormation stack was deployed to the wrong region. A Glue job is regional and can't be moved in place; it also depends on the IAM role and S3 buckets the same stack created alongside it. So getting it into {{troubleshooting-multiservice-glue-c3j34cj9z-us-west-2-ExpectedRegion}} means redeploying the whole stack there, not just recreating the job, then tearing down the {{troubleshooting-multiservice-glue-c3j34cj9z-us-west-2-DeploymentRegion}} stack if unwanted.
